11-After installation of all modules, contractor has to recheck the tilt of the complete MMS . It should be at instructed .angle ( 5, 16, 21, 23 or 43 degree if any )

The debit note for deduction from monthly bill, against such theft and/or power generation loss/loses shall be Immediately
handed over to Gajanand Security.
10 Any FIR/report to Police due to theft shall be filed by Gajanand Security immediately and copy of the same shall be given to Rays.
11 lf any security personnel found engaged in altercation with any employee of Rays,Gajanand Security shall remove him within Twenty Four Hours of such incidence.
12 Any security personnel found sleeping during duty hour shall be treated as absent and his salary for the day shall be deducted from the bill of Gajanand Security.
13 Any security personnel of Gajanand Security shall not allow exit of any type of transport carrying material from site to any destination
without getting clearance from Head Office, Jaipur.
14 That Rays Power shall in no way be held responsible for any bodily injuries sustained/death of any security guard while in duty. Gajanand Security shall alone be liable to pay any compensation to the security personnel or their dependent directly.
15 if there is any unusual activity or violation at site by you or your security personnel then company will terminate the work order on immediate effect and company will not be responsible for compensation of any loss without any clause and penalty of Rs. 100000 will be charged on you.

17 All the facility such as Drinking water including water for other purposes like bath etc. is also included in the above mentioned amountand will be in the scope of contractor only.
18 Guards supplied by the contractor shall be in the dress code and safety shoes during duty hour which shall be provided by the contractor,
for which contractor will not claim any amount.
19 All the facilities such as fooding , lodging will be in the scope of contractor and In addition Company will provide accommodation forthem in plant area.
20 The Contractor will maintain the colour card as advised for daily attendance, which will be signed by the concerned Engineer with time of reporting and release. Bill shall be released on attachment of those
cards along with the attendance sheet. This bill will be certified by the Engineer I/C and Admin representative and will be forwarded to Jaipur
for release of payment.
21 Working hours of each security guard , supervisor will be of 8-10 hr each days and as engagement charges including supervision on full month attendance basis.
23 If there would be need to increase the nos of security guards than RPEPL will inform/ confirm you on mail and than your Service Order will
be amended accordingly.
22 Contractor have to provide verified invoices of each month timely till 3-4 working days of next month and any three month old invoice will not be accepted in any stage and it will be the responsibility of
contractor itself.
23 Contractor have to provide their A/C ledger statement on each 3 month of year and have to reconcile the same with RPEPL office itselfon each quarter.

Insurance:-
 The Contractor shall cover the risks associated with its security guards, vehicles, tools and tackles. In the event, an insurance claims is made by the contractor, RPEPL shall not issue the NOC with respect to the proceeds of such claims and RPEPL will not be liable to pay any claim in such cases.
INSURANCE: 					
Insurance for all the Manpower, Tools & Tackels, Machinery and other which are deputed by contractor will be in the scope of contractor itself and Rays Power shall not be responsible for the such claims.	

DISPUTE RESOLUTIONS: 
Any disputes arises between the parties will be resolved amicably with mutual discussion. In case of non-resolution of the dispute, the same will be resolved as per the Arbitration consolation Act-1996. Jurisdiction of the all legal dispute will be at Jaipur, Rajasthan.

11-After installation of all modules, contractor has to recheck the tilt of the complete MMS . It should be at instructed .angle ( 5, 16, 21, 23 or 43 degree if any ) 
12-There should not be any difference in level of adjacent table.

2346113000023559483.terms:
The Contractor shall provide a valid Security Deployment Letter/License. Security Guards must be between 22 to 45 years of age and possess a minimum qualification of 10th standard. The Contractor shall submit documentary proof confirming:

Compliance with Minimum Wages Act

Coverage under PF and ESIC along with applicable benefits

Identification documents of each deployed guard to the Site Admin

The entire responsibility for providing security services through its personnel shall rest with SSNS Rathore Security. Rays Power shall not be liable to pay any amount towards such security/guards/personnel except as agreed under this contract.

SSNS Rathore Security shall ensure that all personnel deployed at the site are efficient, skilled, and honest.

The Contractor shall provide proper uniforms to its personnel and ensure neatness and cleanliness. Periodical health check-ups shall be arranged by the agency, and certificates shall be regularly submitted to Rays Power.

Identity Cards shall be issued to all security personnel by the Contractor. Each guard shall wear a name plate on the chest during duty hours.

Rays Power shall have privity of contract only with SSNS Rathore Security. All instructions shall be issued only to the Contractor. Rays Power shall not be concerned with employment conditions of the Contractor’s staff.

Rays Power shall not retain any control or supervision over discharge, dismissal, or retrenchment of security personnel deployed by the Contractor.

The Contractor shall provide names, local and permanent addresses, and ID proofs of deployed personnel to Rays Power.

Suitable conveyance shall be arranged by SSNS Rathore Security for round-the-clock surveillance. All fuel and vehicle expenses shall be borne by the Contractor. A patrolling vehicle shall be provided as and when directed by Rays Power.

The Contractor shall provide foolproof security coverage. In case of theft resulting in material loss and/or power generation loss, SSNS Rathore Security shall bear the cost of stolen material and financial losses. Debit notes for such losses shall be immediately handed over to the Contractor.

Any FIR/report due to theft shall be filed immediately by SSNS Rathore Security, and a copy shall be submitted to Rays Power.

If any security personnel is involved in altercation with Rays employees, the Contractor shall remove such personnel within 24 hours.

Any guard found sleeping during duty hours shall be treated as absent, and the salary for that day shall be deducted from the monthly bill.

No security personnel shall allow exit of any transport carrying material from the site without clearance from Head Office, Jaipur.

Rays Power shall not be responsible for any bodily injury or death of security personnel during duty. SSNS Rathore Security shall be solely liable for compensation.

In case of unusual activity or violation by the Contractor or its personnel, the company may terminate the work order immediately without compensation. A penalty of ₹1,00,000/- shall be imposed.

Contract Price:

₹8,70,420/- (Rupees Eight Lakh Seventy Thousand Four Hundred Twenty Only) per month

4-wheeler charges at ₹10 per km (as per running meter)

Applicable for 60 personnel including supervision

12 working hours per day on full-month attendance basis

All facilities such as drinking water (including water for bathing and other purposes) are included in the contract amount and fall within the Contractor’s scope.

Guards must wear dress code and safety shoes during duty, provided by the Contractor at no additional cost.

Fooding and lodging shall be in the Contractor’s scope.

The Contractor shall maintain a color card system for daily attendance, signed by the Site Head, Security Incharge, and Administrative Head with reporting and relieving time. Bills shall be processed only upon submission of signed attendance sheets and certified by Security and Administrative Heads.

If there is a requirement to increase the number of guards, RPEPL shall inform/confirm via email, and the Service Order shall be amended accordingly.

Monthly verified invoices must be submitted within 3–4 working days of the following month. Invoices older than three months shall not be accepted.

The Contractor shall provide an A/C ledger statement every quarter and reconcile the same with the RPEPL office.

No leave shall be allowed for guards. The Security Vendor shall ensure immediate replacement for any guard on leave without affecting deployment strength.

1.	Work order copy, BOQ list, Form (format to be decided) & power of attorney (if any other person is sent by Vendor)

Insurance for all the Manpower, Tools & Tackels, Machinery and other which are deputed by contractor will be in the scope of contractor itself and Rays Power shall not be responsible for the such claims.	

DISPUTE RESOLUTIONS: 
Any disputes arises between the parties will be resolved amicably with mutual discussion. In case of non-resolution of the dispute, the same will be resolved as per the Arbitration consolation Act-1996. Jurisdiction of the all legal dispute will be at Jaipur, Rajasthan.
 
LABOR DEPLOYMENT:				
Contractor have to provide labor deployment latter/ License with supporting of DOB certificate of deployed labor, documents to proof to ensure labors are covered under Minimum wages by contractor, documents to proof to ensure labors are covered under PF , ESIC and its benefits.

SAFETY GUIDELINES	
The contractor shall adhere and strictly follow all the safety guide lines of Rays Power Experts Ltd. and will arrange the required safety material (PPE) at the time of execution. Deputation of Site Supervisor is highly recommended every Work Location. Worker Fitness certificate on Rays Power format to company before start to work.				
Site Requirement -First Aid Box, Drinking water, Induction Room, Office Room, Safety PPE'S as per work requirement it will be in M/s Contractor scope.				
All the required tools & tackles, machineries required to arrange by Contractor will with valid fitness certificate and for same no extra cost will be given.				
Tractors are restricted for labour movement.  For materials tractors to be used must have 360 coupling 				
Safety at works Contractor shall adhere and strictly follow all the safety guide lines of company and will arrange the required safety material (PPE) at the time of execution. Required a permanent supervisor from the contractor side on a daily basis, subcontracting the WO is not acceptable.					
Deputation of Site Supervisor is highly recommended at work location. The contractor shall ensure discipline and good conduct of their staff and workers at project. Even after instruction if contractor violates safety standards, norms, practices, Rays Power reserves right to levy appropriate penalty on contractor and same can be adjusted/recover from pending payables of contractor.

For all technical information and clarifications, you may contact: Priyash at HO and at Site head

3060990000000697024.terms:
Provision of Security Services
Client: RPE Technologies Pvt Ltd ("the Company") Contractor: Dhancholiya Security Services ("the Contractor")
1. LICENSING & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE
1.1 The Contractor shall hold and produce a valid Security Deployment Letter / License prior to commencement of services.
1.2 The Contractor shall submit documentary proof of:
●	(a) Compliance with the Minimum Wages Act;
●	(b) Coverage of all deployed personnel under PF and ESIC, together with all applicable benefits;
●	(c) Identification documents of each deployed guard, to be furnished to the Site Admin.
1.3 The Contractor shall provide the name, local address, permanent address, ID proof and date-of-birth certificate of every deployed guard to the Company.
2. ELIGIBILITY OF SECURITY PERSONNEL
Criteria	Requirement
Age	 22 to 45 years
Minimum qualification	10th standard
Attributes	Efficient, skilled and honest

3. RELATIONSHIP OF PARTIES
3.1 Full and sole responsibility for the provision of security services through its personnel rests with the Contractor.
3.2 The Company shall have privity of contract only with the Contractor. All instructions shall be issued to the Contractor alone.
3.3 The Company shall not be concerned with, nor exercise any control or supervision over, the employment conditions, discharge, dismissal or retrenchment of the Contractor's personnel.
3.4 The Company shall not be liable to pay any amount towards such security personnel except as expressly agreed under this contract.
4. UNIFORM, IDENTITY & HEALTH
4.1 The Contractor shall provide proper uniforms and safety shoes at no additional cost, and shall ensure neatness and cleanliness at all times.
4.2 Identity Cards shall be issued by the Contractor to all security personnel. Each guard shall wear a name plate on the chest during duty hours.
4.3 Periodical health check-ups shall be arranged by the Contractor, and certificates shall be submitted to the Company on a regular basis.
5. SCOPE OF SECURITY COVERAGE
5.1 The Contractor shall provide foolproof security coverage of the site.
5.2 Suitable conveyance shall be arranged by the Contractor for round-the-clock surveillance. All fuel and vehicle expenses shall be borne by the Contractor.
5.3 No security personnel shall permit the exit of any transport carrying material from the site without clearance from Head Office, Jaipur.
6. LOSS, THEFT & LIABILITY
6.1 In the event of theft resulting in material loss and/or power-generation loss, the Contractor shall bear the cost of stolen material and all consequent financial losses. Debit notes for such losses shall be handed over to the Contractor immediately.
6.2 Any FIR / police report in respect of theft shall be filed immediately by the Contractor, and a copy submitted to the Company.
6.3 The Company shall not be responsible for any bodily injury or death of security personnel during duty. The Contractor shall be solely liable for compensation.
7. CONDUCT & DISCIPLINE
Event	Consequence
Guard involved in an altercation with Company employees	Removal by the Contractor within 24 hours
Guard found sleeping during duty hours	Treated as absent; day's salary deducted from the monthly bill
Unusual activity or violation by the Contractor or its personnel	Immediate termination of the Work Order without compensation, plus penalty of ₹1,00,000/-

8. CONTRACT PRICE & COMMERCIAL TERMS
8.1 Rate: ₹18,000/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand Only) per person per month.
8.2 Coverage: 24 working hours per day, on a full-month attendance basis.
8.3 Fooding and lodging shall be entirely within the Contractor's scope.
8.4 Variation in strength: Any requirement to increase the number of guards shall be confirmed by the Company via email, and the Service Order shall be amended accordingly.
9. INVOICING
9.1 Monthly verified invoices shall be submitted within 3–4 working days of the following month.
9.2 Invoices older than three (3) months shall not be accepted.
10. LEAVE & REPLACEMENT
10.1 No leave shall be allowed for guards.
10.2 The Contractor shall ensure immediate replacement of any guard on leave, without any reduction in deployment strength.
11. INSURANCE
11.1 Insurance of all manpower, tools, tackles, machinery and other equipment deployed by the Contractor shall be within the Contractor's scope.
11.2 The Company shall not be responsible for any such claims.
12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
12.1 Any dispute arising between the parties shall first be resolved amicably by mutual discussion.
12.2 Failing amicable resolution, the dispute shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
12.3 Jurisdiction for all legal disputes shall vest exclusively in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
13. LABOUR DEPLOYMENT
13.1 The Contractor shall furnish a Labour Deployment Letter / License, supported by:
●	Date-of-birth certificates of deployed labour;
●	Proof of coverage under the Minimum Wages Act;
●	Proof of coverage under PF, ESIC and associated benefits.
